nodes.question: What is the significance of value-belief-norm theory in predicting workplace energy conservation behaviour?
nodes.answer: The value-belief-norm theory helps in understanding the influence of personal values, beliefs, and social norms on individuals' behaviour towards conserving energy in the workplace. By considering these factors, organizations can predict and encourage energy-saving practices among employees.
